changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_search_doc ( page_id bigint PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES page(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, space_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES space(id), title text NOT NULL, body text NOT NULL, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_search_title ON page_search_doc USING gin (title gin_bigm_ops)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_search_body ON page_search_doc USING gin (body gin_bigm_ops)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_search_space ON page_search_doc (space_id)
